IGUI_MilitaryDrop_AdminUI_Desc_teleport: Move only the requesting admin to a verified free square near this location. No invincibility granted.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_AdminUI_Desc_announce: Broadcast the delivered position again. No new crate or reward.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_AdminUI_Desc_cancelDro: Cancel the flight and pending delivery. No later crate, reward or trust penalty.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_AdminUI_Desc_closeDrop: Stop tracking and reminders. Preserve the physical crate and contents. No reward or trust loss.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_AdminUI_Desc_succeed: Close as successful, applying the normal reward once to the displayed recipient. Daily limit applies.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_AdminUI_Desc_closeMiss: Administrative closure: no reward or penalty. Keep remaining zombies and scenery; schedule the next mission normally.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_AdminUI_Desc_launch: Start a normal mission of this type if none is open. Ordinary announcements and scheduling apply.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_AdminUI_Desc_restore: Lift the outage and cancel repairs without consuming components. No XP or trust reward.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_AdminUI_Desc_unlock: Lift only the selected character line cut. Trust is unchanged.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_AdminUI_MissionCancell: Mission closed by administration, without reward or penalty.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_AdminUI_mainPlayerOnly: Native MP travel is available to the primary local player only.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_AdminUI_busy: Please wait briefly, then retry the intervention.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_AdminUI_toolUnavailabl: Requires the original permission; Fulton also needs debug mode and an active test where applicable.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_AdminUI_toolSent: Action sent. Follow the form or feedback from the existing tool.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_AdminUI_Desc_forceDrop: Open the admin requisition form, or drop directly if disabled. No radio required; no trust reward.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_AdminUI_Desc_crashNext: Arm one crash for the next departure, not a flight already airborne.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_AdminUI_Desc_fultonSta: Start the existing shared balloon visual test near your character.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_AdminUI_Desc_fultonVan: Launch the vanilla floating-item comparison test.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_AdminUI_Desc_fultonPau: Freeze or resume your active test flight.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_AdminUI_Desc_fultonSto: Stop your selected test flight; ordinary Fulton shipments are separate.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_AdminUI_Desc_fultonCab: Toggle the cable in your local rendering.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_AdminUI_Desc_fultonWor: Use only the vanilla floating world item.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_AdminUI_Desc_launchRel: Disable this relay and announce its repair mission. New drops stop; existing flights continue. Normal repair costs, XP and trust apply. Ignores weather/rearm timing; cannot replace an active relay mission.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_AdminUI_relayMissionAc: A relay repair mission is already active.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_PostRelayInstructions: Reach the announced relay cabinet with Electronics Scrap. Right-click the cabinet and choose Repair. Electricity reduces the cost from 20 to 2 scrap and the duration from 15 to 3 seconds. Grants Electricity XP and trust. No generator required. Repair the cabinet on site, not from this console.
